profile.headline: Always learning and improving. I enjoy solving problems, simplifying complexity, and delivering quality work. Oh, and perfecting my corned beef recipe!
profile.summary:
I'm a versatile, creative and ambitious full-stack software development professional with over 12 years of programming experience who loves learning and implementing new frameworks and technology.
I am skilled in event-driven architectures, Net, C#,  JavaScript, MVC, SQL Server, AWS. I have a strong IT and client relations background along with a-great work ethic and result driven focus.
I have been programming in one form or another since my youth.
Advancements in technology have always interested me, so my eyes and ears are always open to new development, staying mindful of what I learn while working on my software.
I pride myself on my language skills and leverage those skills to write effective, well-documented code.
I love transforming software as something from imagination into a reality!

positions.title: Executive Customer Support Specialist
positions.description:
Provide end-user support and technical issue resolution via phone, email, and other electronic medium related to supported applications

Participate in the Customer Support Call Center queue for State and Federal end-user inquiries

Update end-users on any open tickets in a timely manner

Promptly escalate difficult issues to the department supervisor or to cross functional department for immediate resolution

Verify that application updates are applied and working properly in relation to open end-user tickets
